# CoopAI

> VS Code code intelligence for production teams. Deep-Index your repos (zero-clone), query company Slack, Jira, and docs live, then ask, complete, and edit in the open file.

CoopAI is a VS Code extension — not an autonomous coding agent. It helps engineers understand existing codebases without cloning the monorepo, using a remote code graph plus admin-connected company tools (shared org context, not each developer’s personal accounts).

## Canonical facts

- Product type: VS Code code intelligence layer (chat, quick actions, inline complete, reviewable edits)
- Not: a terminal agent that rewrites the tree on its own
- Indexing: Deep-Index / Lightning builds a searchable graph, then deletes the temporary clone (zero-clone)
- Stack tools: Slack, Jira, Confluence, Notion, Google Docs, Teams are queried live at ask time from the admin-connected company workspace
- Workflows: Understand Repo, Trace Decision, Find Owner, Blast Radius, Knowledge Gaps
- Auth model: org admin connects integrations once; developers sign in — no personal OAuth paste in production
